errors.text: The proposed FCC phase is TiO, an oxygen-derived ceramic precipitate, not a second metallic solid-solution phase; therefore the central claim of a dual-phase solid-solution constitution is not supported by E4.
No cited evidence establishes a grain size below 50 nm for the proposed NbMoTaWVTi bulk alloy.

The falsification experiment simultaneously changes grain size, phase constitution, defect density, and precipitation state, so it cannot distinguish grain-boundary or precipitation strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening.
The claimed stability limits above 1200 degrees C and beyond 60 hours of milling are asserted without direct supporting evidence.
